name: worldprofit-social
description: Create branded, image-enhanced Worldprofit posts for Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Instagram feed, then publish or schedule them after approval.

interface.shortDescription: Create, approve, publish, and schedule branded social posts.

defaultPrompt: Create Worldprofit posts for Facebook, X, and both my LinkedIn profile and Worldprofit company Page, plus the @worldprofit Instagram feed.
